text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the 
courtyard……

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! You over there! Care to stop and 
watch my magic trick?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: So, the one you picked is――

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: It's the Jack of Spades!! Am I right?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Daaamn it~! Failed again! I really can't 
pull it off like Fuji-san does.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-san can pull off that card guessing 
trick in the blink of an eye, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
When I asked how it's done, she just went, 
"It's the same as racing." Hearing 
something like that...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ain't no way I'm passin' that up, y'know?! 
So, I've been givin' it a shot since last 
week, but—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Not a siiiingle one of 'em succeeded, 
dammit!!
choice_data_list:
Even if you fail, the important thing is 
to keep at it.

Watch their technique and learn from the 
example!

text_block_list.text: They're right, Pocket.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: F-Fuji-san!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I heard a rumor that someone's been 
practicing magic tricks around here 
lately... so I wondered if it might be 
you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You know, Pokke, the secret to magic 
tricks is... failing until you're sick of 
it before the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Get the failure out of the way...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! And when the big day comes, you 
ensure the fruits of your labor show "as 
if it were only natural"! —Doesn't that 
sound familiar to something else?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Racing...! Oh, so that's what you meant!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I wanna pull off flashy moves on the big 
stage just like Fuji-san! I'm gonna 
practice magic and racing like crazy from 
now on!!
A few days later――

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, Jordan, the card you picked was— 
the 4 of Diamonds! ...Am I right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it hit!! For real!? Pokke, how the 
heck did you pull that off!!?

It looks like Jungle Pocket overcame her 
initial blunders and successfully mastered 
the magic trick.

They say you should learn techniques by 
watching the master. If I observe Fuji 
Kiseki's magic tricks closely, maybe I can 
figure out the knack to it.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Right on! Pretty sure Fuji-san had a magic 
trick video up on UmaTok――

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, this magic trick! —Man, I have 
zero clue when she swapped the card...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, this magic trick is crazy too!? 
...Whoa!? A dove came out!!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
――Ah, wait, this isn't a magic trick, it's 
a training video…… Whoa, what incredible 
running……!

I ended up watching videos with Jungle 
Pocket that had nothing to do with magic 
tricks...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Man, Fuji-san's running really is unreal!! 
How do I put it…… it's like she blows your 
mind in the most dazzling way possible—
choice_data_list: That was dazzling, like a magic trick.
That was dazzling, like a magic trick.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! That's it, that's the one! It 
really sends a spark through you, doesn't 
it?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Man, talking about this is getting me all 
fired up to go run together...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! I'm gonna go find Fuji-san and 
ask her to run alongside me! Thanks for 
tagging along!

Her admiration for Fuji Kiseki's running 
seems to be the driving force behind 
Jungle Pocket's actions――
